Title: Learning and Training Overview
Summary: The chapter sets up the next video by introducing the concept of learning—adjusting weights and biases through data to improve performance. It hints at gradient descent and backpropagation as the mechanisms behind training, while acknowledging the complexity of the process. The video concludes with a brief acknowledgment of Patreon supporters and a playful nudge to subscribe, framing the recommendation algorithm as a neural network that learns viewer preferences.
